summary: Copper futures on New York’s Comex climbed to a record high as investors awaited a decision on US tariffs, while also tracking a push to reopen the Strait of Hormuz that lifted demand for risk assets.

title: US Diesel Exports Surge to Record as World Grasps for Supply
summary: The US shipped a record amount of distillate fuel overseas last week as domestic stockpiles fell again, the latest sign that the global scramble for diesel is increasingly draining US supplies.

title: Starboard Value Has Taken a Position in Shake Shack, CEO Smith Says

title: Disney’s Streaming and Parks Drive Third-Quarter Profits
summary: Walt Disney's profit beat Wall Street estimates in the company’s fiscal third quarter, driven by soaring income from its entertainment division and the resilience of its theme parks in California and Florida. Bloomberg's Geetha Ranganathan joins Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss Disney as well as Paramount Skydance's earnings. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: UK’s Bodycote Draws £1.6 Billion Bids From CVC and Veritas
summary: Bodycote Plc received takeover bids worth around £1.6 billion ($2.2 billion) each from CVC Advisers Ltd. and Veritas Capital, pitting rival private equity firms against one another.

title: S&P 500 Fluctuates After Record-Breaking Advance: Markets Wrap
summary: Stocks wavered near all-time highs as traders digested a recent rally and a slew of corporate earnings. Oil steadied on hopes for a reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Stocks Rise on Earnings and Hopes for Hormuz Deal
summary:
A slew of strong corporate profits sent stocks to fresh all-time highs, with the market also rising as President Donald Trump said a deal on the Strait of Hormuz is possible as early as Wednesday.
While equities pared earlier gains, the S&P 500 headed toward its longest winning streak since June.
Alicia Levine, CIO at BNY Wealth, discusses the path ahead for the S&P 500. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: SoftBank-Backed OfBusiness Said to Weigh Reviving India IPO
summary: OFB Tech Pvt, the operator of technology supply chain and financing platform OfBusiness, is considering reviving plans for an initial public offering that could raise as much as $800 million, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Muni Market on Pace for 3rd Consecutive Year of Record Issuance
summary:
Municipal bond technicals remain highly constructive, helping the market easily absorb issuance running at a record pace. 
Yet geopolitical and monetary-policy concerns have pushed global nominal yields higher during the third rate-markets pullback of the year. 
Nisha Patel, Senior Portfolio Manager: Fixed Income at Parametric, talks about the tough month for municipals and bond market warnings. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 5
summary: Oil fluctuated amid mounting signs that the US and Iran are nearing a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, potentially restoring millions of barrels a day of production disrupted by the months-long conflict.

title: Wall Street Banker Bonuses Could Rise by 15%, Says Johnson Associates Study
summary: Chris Connors, managing director at Johnson Associates, says Wall Street bankers could be having one of their best years ever. He says bonuses could rise by 10% to 15% or more for investment and commercial bankers. But he says some sectors are being left behind. He speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: ¿Quién debería decidir el destino de las obras de Frida Kahlo?
summary: ¿Por qué una de las colecciones más importantes de Frida Kahlo saldrá de México? El traslado a España desató un debate sobre patrimonio, transparencia y quién debe proteger las obras más emblemáticas del país. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Disney Climbs on Profit Beat; AMD Falls on Underwhelming Forecast | Stock Movers
summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) shares are lower after the semiconductor firm’s second-quarter revenue and third-quarter sales forecast underwhelmed investors expecting a stronger performance given rising demand. 
- Disney (DIS) shares are climbing as profit beat Wall Street estimates in the company’s fiscal third quarter, driven by soaring income from its entertainment division and the resilience of its theme parks in California and Florida.
- Shopify (SHOP) shares are soaring after it reported revenue for the second quarter that beat the average analyst estimate. President Harley Finkelstein said it was a "monster quarter" for the company. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Services Industry Expands at a Steady Pace
